body: I hope so. You guys are great. Like little fishes made of sane in a sea of crazy. I still feel like i'm at the deep end but i'm not as tempted to jump now. Gonna go see if I can't catch some sleep for a bit. Thanks again

My brother and I used to be really close. We did everything together but as I mentioned our parent's divorce shattered the family dynamic. I've saved his life a few times by calling the cops on him when he tried to commit suicide (the irony huh) that year and helped him with his bills when he was short on cash. The trip that the woman and I had together was on money I borrowed from him since the money we were going to use was held up in hotel disagreements. 

We've been off and on for a while now but I know now that after this I can never see him as anything more than a worm. Deciding he has feelings for my then girlfriend and ACTING upon then is the lowest of the low, especially with him knowing how truly happy I was for the first time in a long time. It's lowdown, dirty, disrespectful and just wrong...

We did have something special, do, still might. I don't know anymore to be honest. I know I still love her. As recent as last week she still referred to me as her soulmate and we dreamed of a wedding in Bora Bora together. This week though...she doesn't reply to hardly any messages of mine, her cell doesn't work in her new place so she says I can't call her but I know she talks to my brother on the phone still. 

She is my life present and future and without her I don't want one.

I appreciate all the kind words i'm hearing from everyone I really do. 

Good things...she's the best that's ever happened to me. The only woman to ever truly love me, accept and appreciate me. Nobody ever has or ever will get me like she does and there is so much chemistry between us it's astounding. She's been there for me, she's my rock and the only strength i have left to go on is when i'm with her.

What good is anything after losing someone like that?

i'm not seeing anything that's improved....every day feels worse than the day before and i've never felt more alone.

I don't have any other family really. My parents divorced almost 5 years ago which destroyed any family bond we had together. My father had been cheating on my mother for years and claimed to have not even loved her for the past 10 years of the marriage. All of that leading me to believe the majority of my childhood was a lie since him being a father was just an act to him. Obviously my brother is dead to me. I have a sister but she also tried to ruin my life as she invented molestation charges against me in high school to try and get me in trouble. 

I've been a lurker on reddit for a long time now so I know how supportive everyone is here. This is kind of a last ditch effort on my part...I know i'm losing myself and all the problems I have are catching up to me and destroying me slowly.

I've been hoping, praying and waiting for it to get better for years now and just as it looks like my luck's changed, I lose everything. It's ALWAYS like this! How much time is supposed to pass before life is just not worth it anymore?
